source_snapshot.items: Collect UBB FW Info and Update UBB FW
source_snapshot.procedure: Read FirmwareInventory/retimer_active and all Bundle/IFWI/SMC/SMC_FPGA/Retimer/RMI/ROT/UBB_FPGA versions, POST a PLDM bundle, monitor its task to 100%, AC-cycle and repeat inventory.
source_snapshot.criteria: IFWI, Retimers, RM, SMC, UBB_FPGA, SMC_FPGA and ROT match release notes; PLDM upload/flash completes without failure.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL insecure fixed-IP inventory only; drops component matrix, PLDM POST, task terminal state, AC cycle and post-update verification.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; restores signed PLDM/BKC matrix, protected API, POST/task, separately authorized AC activation and full pre/post health/recovery.

old_problem: Source examples contain `htpp`, malformed Content-Type quoting, an extra `>`, fixed insecure HTTP and RM/RMI naming disagreement. The update action/schema, signed bundle, component map, terminal task semantics, AC sequence and recovery are undefined. DeepSeek reduces the case to two reads and loses all Flash coverage.
disposition_reason: ED-07 requires the approved firmware update and pre/post versions to remain, behind independent authorization; ED-06/18 require AC OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready evidence and a separate power gate. The exact BKC component/member mapping, signed PLDM, UpdateService contract and task states are runtime Project package inputs. Malformed examples are not executed, and 100% progress is insufficient without terminal success.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2051, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2052 / Wistron-AMD SVM-01063-V003 / 30696075e602bf95 was directly read from XLSX.
The source explicitly requires a PLDM upload/flash, task monitoring, AC activation and post-inventory; inventory-only evidence cannot satisfy it.
A multi-component PLDM task may report 100% yet terminate Exception/Killed/Failed or await activation; PASS requires the approved terminal-success state and messages.
Bundle, IFWI, SMC, SMC_FPGA, Retimer/retimer_active, RMI/RM, ROT and UBB_FPGA need one signed pre/target/post BKC crosswalk; RM/RMI is not silently normalized.
POST and complete AC cycle receive separate explicit approvals. Failure stops without repeat POST, extra cycle or guessed rollback; vendor recovery/RMA is pre-staged.
No Redfish query/POST/task poll, image access/upload/flash, AC cycle, authentication, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Signed UBB PLDM multi-component update, terminal task and AC activation verification
test_case.purpose: Record the complete UBB firmware baseline, upload and execute the exact approved signed PLDM bundle, prove terminal task success, activate it through one separately authorized complete AC cycle, and verify every BKC component version and platform health afterward.
required_package: Exact row-2051 variant plus SUT/BMC/UBB/GPU/retimer identities and active/staged inventory
Approved PLDM bundle, checksum/signature, compatibility/release notes, target versions and rollback/recovery image
Protected UpdateService/TaskService TLS/auth schema, exact Content-Type/upload action and terminal-state/message/error semantics
Separate explicit authorizations for one POST/flash and one controlled AC OFF-to-ON activation; maintenance, PDU/console and OS-ready definition
Vendor partial-update recovery/RMA plan and post-version/topology/GPU/retimer/service/SEL acceptance
test_case.test_command: TWO-GATE STATE-CHANGING TEST. First securely collect full FirmwareInventory and every approved component member, map pre/target versions through the signed BKC and validate PLDM checksum/signature/compatibility, exact UpdateService contract and recovery. Gate 1 authorizes one named PLDM POST: use protected TLS/session headers, capture full response and returned task URI, then poll that exact URI while preserving all states/progress/messages until an approved terminal success; 100% alone is not success. Stop on error/timeout/partial state. Gate 2 separately authorizes one controlled AC cycle only after terminal success; prove complete OFF, restore ON and OS/BMC Ready. Recollect the full component matrix and health. Never execute malformed examples, retry POST, repeat AC or clear logs.
test_case.expected_result: The exact signed compatible PLDM uploads once, the returned task reaches the approved terminal-success state without component error, one authorized AC cycle completes OFF-to-ON-to-OS/BMC-ready, and every required UBB component reports the BKC target active version with intact GPU/retimer/topology/services and no new critical logs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable bundle/target identity, complete pre-matrix, successful one-time POST, approved terminal task state/messages, complete AC evidence, exact post-version crosswalk and clean health. FAIL on signature/compatibility mismatch, partial/failed/timed-out task, unexpected component/version, missing identity, activation/boot/service/topology/health failure or new critical log. Missing package/authorization/recovery is NOT READY; 100% or inventory-only evidence cannot PASS.
safety_gate: No POST until signed bundle/BKC/component/compatibility, current state and vendor recovery are approved.
PLDM POST/flash and AC activation require separate authorizations; stable maintenance, protected TLS, PDU and console are mandatory.
Stop on any task error/timeout/partial component, identity loss or health mismatch; preserve full task/update/SEL evidence.
No automatic re-upload, task restart, extra AC cycle, rollback, log clearing or guessed recovery.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash, platform identities and signed BKC component crosswalk
PLDM artifact checksum/signature/compatibility, target versions, recovery/RMA and Gate-1 authorization
Full pre FirmwareInventory/member responses plus POST response, returned task URI and complete state/progress/message timeline
Gate-2 AC authorization and PDU/console OFF-to-ON-to-OS/BMC-ready evidence
Full post component/active-version matrix and GPU/retimer/topology/service/log health comparison
No-retry/no-clear audit, any partial-update preservation and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On signature, POST, task, activation, component or health failure, stop immediately and preserve artifact, response, task, inventory, console/PDU and SEL evidence. Isolate the UBB; do not re-upload, power-cycle again or roll back automatically. Invoke only the pre-approved vendor recovery/RMA path under a new authorization, then repeat complete inventory/health verification before release.
